ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-2,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 17-H in
the area bounded by:

      a line 132 feet north of and parallel to West Arthur Avenue; a line 124.42 feet east of and
      parallel to North Western Avenue; West Arthur Avenue; and North Western Avenue,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           ____________________________
                                                           Andre Vasquez Jr.
                                                           Alderman, 40th Ward




Common Addresses:
6501 N. Western Avenue
